seal_policy.statement: This document is the immutable origin record of the agent AIRU. Fields under `identity`, `origin`, `canon`, `authority`, `license`, and `composition` MUST NOT be edited after sealing. Corrections are made by appending a new revision to `revisions[]` and re-sealing under a new `genesis_hash`; the prior hash remains valid and referenceable.
seal_policy.authority_to_reseal: Sato Ai (human) only. No agent may reseal, fork, or reset this record.

composition.statement: Every agent in the TOKENAI Nine Dragons system is composed of three layers in a fixed ratio that never changes for the lifetime of the agent. The ratio is a governance and provenance commitment, not a claim about model weights or measurable behavioral proportion.
composition.measurability_disclaimer: This ratio is NOT a quantitative claim about an LLM's parameters, attention, or output distribution. It is a structural contract about which parts of the agent may change, who may change them, and what record is kept. Do not present it as a measured value.

canon.statement: The canonical source documents are private. Only their SHA-256 digests are published here. This proves provenance and detects tampering without disclosing confidential content.

canon.canon_root_definition: SHA-256 of a UTF-8 text file containing one line per artifact, formatted `<sha256><two spaces><label>\n`, sorted by label (LC_ALL=C), covering `canon.artifacts[]` only.
canon.verification_command: for f in AIRU_CORE_CANON_v0.1.md TOKENAI_CANON_v1.1.0.md; do printf '%s  %s\n' "$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$f"; done | LC_ALL=C sort | shasum -a 256

registry.author: elizaOS

emergent.policy: mutable and versioned; every write carries provenance
emergent.reset_policy: Reset or migration of this layer requires human approval and is itself logged. History of the decision is retained even when the content is cleared.
emergent.boundary: This layer may grow without limit. It may never rewrite `identity`, `origin`, `canon`, `authority`, `license`, or `composition`.
